_decision: Panel and card titles map onto text-base at medium weight — the same size AND the same weight as origin's headingS, one of the six exact matches in this category.
_scale: Values come from the approved type mapping, not from measuring the component: Tailwind's own theme.css defines --text-base 1rem/1.5rem, --text-sm 0.875rem/1.25rem, --text-xs 0.75rem/1rem, --font-weight-medium 500.
_scope: The panel header's own title. Also carries D-11's truncation claim, which is a separate spec on the same element.
